_comment: PRODUCTION-FROZEN barrier regression. Charlotte/Mooresville Precision Route 1I (SavedRoute 6a7e7a1c3efa45ba79c806be, 1,000 doors) as an UNORDERED set of doors hydrated from the canonical property store. This is the real route whose 11.927-mile transition was traced to barrier-straddling decomposition, not to macro ordering. Doors carry routing-relevant attributes only - no owner, price, sale or user metadata. Sorted by address_hash so the file is order-independent evidence, never a stored solution.

barrier_evidence._comment: The aerial-near / road-far pair that proves the failure class. Both doors were members of geometric window 0, so the intra-window solver could not escape the crossing. Road miles measured with real road routing on the production engine.

frozen_benchmark._comment: Independently measured real road mileage on the finished order. Same optimizer for every row; only the decomposition strategy differs. These numbers are the production reference behavior - a future change must beat or match them with evidence.
